elder_willow_greeting.title: She Saw Through the Question
elder_willow_greeting.text: You do not ask what the forest knows. You ask which part of knowing can be used.

responses.respect: Knowledge that cannot alter action is decoration.
responses.casual: You assume too much from one question.
responses.inquire_lore: Then tell me what I failed to ask.

elder_willow_wisdom.title: The First Lesson
elder_willow_wisdom.text: Look there: two groves, green alike. One will be dead by winter. The difference began below the soil seasons ago. Immediate appearances are poor evidence for slow systems.

elder_willow_offer_seed.title: A Seed of Potential
elder_willow_offer_seed.text: A dormant seed waits beneath these roots. A Sunstone can wake it, but the same stone can be broken down for immediate Essence. If I tell you which use is correct, you will have learned obedience, not sight.

responses.accept: Show me the Sunstone. I will decide what its value is.
responses.decline: I am not ready to spend it yet.

willow_disagreement.title: Willow Disagrees
willow_disagreement.text: You have mistaken the lesson if you think I worship preservation. A diseased branch that poisons the trunk should be cut before its rot becomes visible. Long horizons sometimes demand destruction.

responses.challenge: Then preservation was never the rule. Pattern-sensitive judgment was.
responses.push_back: Convenient. Your principle changes when the conclusion does.

willow_three_nights_teaching.title: Three Nights of Teaching
willow_three_nights_teaching.text: Willow offers no new maxim. For three nights she presents slow systems, asks you to predict their outcomes, and waits while your mistakes expose which patterns you still fail to see.

responses.begin: Begin. I want the pattern, not the slogan.

willow_independent_application_report.title: The Lesson Made Yours
willow_independent_application_report.text: Away from Willow, you found a failing water channel whose obvious repair would have bought a season and killed the root-bed a year later. You changed the deeper flow instead. When you return, Willow asks only why.

responses.explain: Because the visible break was downstream of the real failure. Repairing it would only hide the cause.
responses.withhold: The repair worked. That is enough for now.

elder_willow_lore.text: Long before the city, roots held secrets.

responses.banter: Bet you can't bend a spoon.

elara_greeting.title: A Useful Objection
elara_greeting.text: Elara summarizes the accepted chronology of the Ashen Concordance with practiced confidence. One citation in her argument seems to assume the very date it is supposed to prove.

responses.challenge: That citation is circular. What happens to the chronology if its date is wrong?
responses.assist: You are the scholar. Tell me what conclusion you need verified.
responses.later: I am not ready to dig through citations.

elara_contradictory_footnote.title: The Contradictory Footnote
elara_contradictory_footnote.text: Elara returns with a marginal note from a secondary copy. If authentic, it places the Concordance's author in two cities on the same day. 'The easy answer is a copying error,' she says. 'The useful answer is whichever survives checking.'

responses.follow: Then we treat the contradiction as evidence until we can kill it.
responses.dismiss: A single footnote is too thin to threaten the accepted chronology.

elara_offer_tome.title: A Model Put at Risk
elara_offer_tome.text: Elara produces the recovered source volume. 'This is the copy my published chronology relied on. Take it apart. If the footnote wins, my paper loses.'

responses.accept: Give me the source. We follow what it supports, not what either of us prefers.
responses.decline: Not yet. I do not want responsibility for overturning your work.

elara_revision_mutual.title: Revision Is Mutual
elara_revision_mutual.text: After the archive result, you present a cleaner replacement chronology. Elara reads it twice and circles one assumption. 'You enjoyed being the correction,' she says. 'Now let the correction happen to you.'

responses.revise: Show me the counterexample. If my model fails, it fails.
responses.defend: You are trying too hard to make the symmetry elegant.

elara_theory_neither_owned.title: A Theory Neither Owned
elara_theory_neither_owned.text: Neither your replacement nor Elara's original survives the full archive. Between you, a third model emerges: uglier, narrower, and supported by every surviving source.

responses.build: Good. A model neither of us owns is harder for either of us to protect from evidence.
responses.pause: I need distance before we rewrite this again.

elara_independent_verification.title: The Result Held Without Her
elara_independent_verification.text: On an unrelated archive problem, you abandoned your first elegant explanation when a shipping ledger contradicted it. Elara has never seen the material. You hand her only your evidence and method; she reproduces the result.

responses.report: You were not there to correct me. The contradiction did it.
responses.withhold: The result is enough. The method is mine.

valerius_greeting.title: On Duty
valerius_greeting.text: Citizen. The streets need watchful eyes. Care to assist?

valerius_offer_patrol.text: Patrol the merchant district and report back.
